demos.name: PingOne Events Lab
demos.description: See what PingOne delivers through a webhook subscription: the events page, delivery health (including the silent discard when a site answers 200 with a web page), and optional forwarding of each event to your Elasticsearch or OpenSearch for Kibana. Mock shows the whole path and its failures with nothing leaving the machine; Real pulls read-only. Also runs on the SE cluster so PingOne can reach the webhook (owner-approved exception, 2026-11-07).
demos.notes: Host-run: ./scripts/run.sh (port 7802). Mock needs no tenant and no credentials. Docker: HOST_PORT=7802 docker compose up --build -d (published on 127.0.0.1 only). Real: PINGONE_* for the read-only pull, ELASTICSEARCH_* to forward; both owner-run and UNVERIFIED against live systems. Run locally it cannot receive PingOne deliveries; the SE deployment (k8s/) does. Catalog id D124 is provisional until the owner confirms.
